review.commerce_description: SparkLaunch uses the connected account's existing entitlements. This plugin does not sell subscriptions or products, initiate payments, transfer funds, sign investment agreements, or finalize investments.

publication.release_notes: Restore connected-account App binding and SparkLaunch skill branding. Include reviewer test cases in the package. The initial public ChatGPT SparkClose surface supports modeling, saved scenarios, readiness, and private investment metadata; agreement preparation, signing and closing workflows are excluded.
